decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a publicly rebranded evolution of the established BASIC 518, so it carries visible commitment and an existing customer base that management would not want to write off.
The AK flail shredder series was upgraded to EU Stage V engines and presented at a trade fair, a recent investment and public commitment that favours persistence.

The mobile high-speed grinder gained its own page in 2019 and fits the core mobile shredding portfolio, and its sister green-waste model was already pruned, which suggests this one was the version chosen to continue.
The CERON generation was publicly claimed to set benchmarks and is referenced in plant installations, so the heavy investment and visible commitment make dropping it unlikely.
